expo.name: FixMate
expo.description: Camera-first repair guidance for UK households: understand likely faults, safety risks, repair costs, and the next step.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FixMate uses your camera to capture photos or short videos of household repair problems for diagnosis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FixMate can include sound when you record a repair video because noises may help identify the fault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FixMate lets you choose a photo or short video of a household repair problem for diagnosis.
